high.title: TSMC Shows Massive Premium in Block Trading - Record 2,020 Yuan Transaction Emerges
high.summary: TSMC (2330) demonstrated remarkable resilience despite ADR weakness, closing down only 1.09% at 1,820 yuan on March 27. Most significantly, block trading after market hours revealed transactions at 2,020 yuan - a sixth-highest historical price and first time above 2,000 yuan since March 10. Six block trades totaled 1,714 shares worth 3.1 billion yuan. The 200-yuan premium between block trading (2,020 yuan) and closing price (1,820 yuan) suggests potential 1,588-point upside for the weighted index, targeting 34,700 points. However, night session futures fell below 1,800 yuan to 1,790 yuan (-1.92%), while far-month contracts recovered to 1,845 yuan, indicating short-term pessimism but longer-term optimism among institutional investors.

high.title: Foreign Investors Dump 38.5 Billion Yuan as Taiwan Stocks Fall 225 Points
high.summary: Taiwan stocks closed down 225 points at 33,112.59 amid heavy foreign selling pressure of 38.47 billion yuan. Foreign investors sold 60,114 shares of 0050 ETF but surprisingly bought 24,119 shares of Winbond Electronics (2344) and 22,461 shares of Compal Electronics (2324), both ex-dividend stocks trading below their adjusted prices. The divergent buying pattern suggests foreigners are accumulating dividend-paying tech stocks at discounted levels. Investment trusts were net buyers of 0.08 billion yuan while dealers sold 1.8 billion yuan. The selling concentration in ETFs while buying individual dividend stocks indicates a strategic shift in foreign investment patterns.

high.title: Taiwan Stock Weekly Loss 1.2% - Analysts Warn Correction Pressure Building
high.summary: Taiwan stocks posted weekly decline of 431 points (-1.2%) with foreign institutions net selling 38.33 billion yuan and increasing short positions by 2,854 contracts to 39,919. Yung Feng Securities warns the current index support by large-cap stocks masks underlying weakness - a typical pattern before corrections. While semiconductor and AI stocks maintain fundamental support preventing clear bearish signals, deteriorating sentiment in small-mid caps and accelerating sector rotation indicate defensive positioning. The firm characterizes current resilience as "delayed reaction rather than genuine strength," warning that extended US market correction will likely trigger catch-up selling pressure in Taiwan equities.

medium.title: New Thousand-Dollar Stock Debuts - Baulect to List at 780 Yuan with 105% Potential Gain
medium.summary: AI-powered semiconductor testing equipment supplier Baulect (7822) will debut on March 30 with IPO price of 780 yuan. Based on March 27 OTC closing at 1,600 yuan, successful applicants could gain 820,000 yuan per lot (105% return). The company's revenue surged from 210 million yuan in 2023 to 2.075 billion yuan in 2025, with EPS growing from 3.84 to 14.04 yuan, driven by advanced packaging demand.

medium.title: Jin Hua Hotel Sells Regent Stake for 1.23 Billion Yuan
medium.summary: Jin Hua International Hotels (2707) announced IHG will acquire 25% stake in Regent brand in two phases totaling US$38.5 million. First phase (13% stake, US$20 million) completes Q1 2026, generating 331 million yuan disposal gain. Since 2010 investment of US$56 million, Jin Hua has now recovered US$77.8 million including 2018 disposal, exceeding original investment.

medium.title: Apple's Folding iPhone Priced at 64,000 Yuan Expected Year-End Launch
medium.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone expected to launch by end-2026 with price exceeding US$2,000 (64,000 yuan), becoming the highest-priced iPhone ever. Hon Hai (2317) assembly, TSMC chips, and related supply chain partners positioned to benefit. Counterpoint Research estimates 28% market share in debut year, challenging Samsung's leadership in foldable segment.
